flows.title: Track time with the timer
steps: Go to the Time Tracker page and click the What are you working on? box.
Type a short description of the task, and optionally select a Project to associate the time with.
Click Start to begin the timer, and click Stop once the task is finished.

flows.title: Enter time manually
steps: Go to the Time Tracker page and click the list icon in the upper right corner to switch to Manual mode.
Enter the start and end time, or just the duration.
Type a description of the task, select a Project, and click Add to save the entry.

flows.title: Create a project
steps: Go to Projects and click Create new project.
Name the project and select its client. A new client can be created here too, by typing a name and clicking Create client.

Choose a project color from the Custom section or the color picker, and choose its visibility. On the Free plan only Public can be set; if the person wants the project Private and Private is missing, locked or leads to another page, stop and tell them, and never change the plan.
